slice: W265 bounded static Compact plain-MRK4 writer extension

claim.adversary: ROBUST within the finite static/plain-MRK3/MRK4 native witness, checked callback association, declared publication/budget guards and exact affected cohort.
claim.scope: One nonempty sorted-UInt64-key part; stateless recursive codecs; single LZ4 stream; plain MRK3 backward-compatible default and explicit plain MRK4; String-v0/BASIC Map. Native qualification is the independently authored eight-column/eight-row/four-real-mark-plus-EOF witness, not every locally admitted declaration.
not_claimed: Stateful LowCardinality/Variant/Dynamic/JSON writers or every recursive type combination
Compressed marks, arbitrary serializer profiles/codecs or all ClickHouse versions
Incremental append, arbitrary table metadata or Compact MV/projection composition
Full writer/reader parity or replacement of prior bounded Wide/metadata MV/projection qualification
Granule-only physical I/O, zero allocation, full allocator/RSS bounds, large-part scaling or speed parity
Combined-RELEASE/order interaction qualification or full-suite GREEN
Identical source/runtime builds, latest upstream or complete server deployment
claim.evidence_policy: Curated index to source-state observations. Fields, structural validation and model agreement are not proof by themselves.

boundaries.risk: CAUTION: persistent serialization, shared backend and staged publication
boundaries.default_deny: Only these 21 W265-owned paths belong to this slice. Protected untracked W263 specs and original captures remain outside staging and mutation.
boundaries.rollback: Revert the W265 commit without discarding protected local specs or captured evidence; no reset, history rewrite or remote action.
boundaries.authority: In-scope local implementation and atomic commit only; no push or original/native-store mutation.

design.shared_codec: BinaryBulkCodec and recursive callback-role traversal remain logical serde owners. CompactStaticWritePlan is the immutable physical callback binding; CompactStaticWriter assembles granule -> column -> callback.
design.mrk4: Headerless adaptive records: 16*S+8 bytes, S checked actual substreams. Keep zero-byte callback positions. Every terminal pair is (data.bin size,0), with parent rows=0.
design.sidecar: columns_substreams.txt is ordered version-1 metadata, in the exact physical file census but intentionally absent from checksums.txt. Exact staged bytes and detached physical roster are checked before publication.
design.validation: Metadata, complete mark/row grid, checksums, fold, key/value typed readback and exclusive publication use the same plan. Grid budgets use actual S, preserve cumulative progress and the unchanged publication mechanism.
design.reuse_boundary: Stateless codecs can emit logical lanes once and slice the tape. Stateful Compact serialization needs a separately qualified per-granule prefix/body/suffix and context-state owner; existing Wide stream envelopes cannot simply be concatenated.

literal_oracle.edge_cases: UInt64::MAX and >2^53; embedded NUL/non-UTF8 and long Strings; NULL, ragged and empty callbacks
literal_oracle.policy: Exact literal rows, not helper signatures alone. Empty aggregate SELECT emits one result row containing count=0, not one logical data row.

physical_oracle.interpretation: Root reconstructs headerless marks and decoded coordinates independently. Compressed bytes/frame counts need not match; no compression or speed claim.

default_mrk3_frozen_oracle.interpretation: Finite prior-backend byte oracle, stronger than default-vs-explicit calls to the new backend; not every static declaration.

native_evidence.availability: Raw records, binaries and capture inventories remain local temporary artifacts, not committed data. Loss requires regeneration/requalification rather than claiming the packet substitutes for them.

adversary.verdict: ROBUST within the declared finite scope
adversary.independence: Same-lineage Luna source/test review is correlated. Root independently executes serial commands, inspects actual source/native raw results and reconstructs stock/physical oracles. Stock literal INSERT is independently authored.
adversary.local_counterexamples: Matched cap permits eight MRK3 slots but rejects actual seventeen MRK4 slots; cumulative staged readback records earlier successful preflights and more than one opened reader. Resealed child-slot and unchanged-checksum sidecar poisons are detected before local publication.

native_mutation_outcomes.local: Selected corrupted pk frame rejects checksum; unselected gap reads.
native_mutation_outcomes.select: Full/middle raise server exception; last/empty remain exact
native_mutation_outcomes.interpretation: Selected-frame lazy authentication, not eager whole-file validation.
Pinned native Compact CHECK skips the uncompressed fold. CHECK/value success does not authenticate this field.

native_mutation_outcomes.mutation: Resealed wrong non-first child coordinate in data.mrk4
native_mutation_outcomes.local: gap rejects: Compact callback tape is truncated
native_mutation_outcomes.interpretation: Native tolerance/sensitivity gap, not proof that native SELECT rejects wrong child coordinates.

native_mutation_outcomes.mutation: Swapped unchecked columns_substreams.txt roster; checksums unchanged
native_mutation_outcomes.interpretation: Exact local roster validation is an additional guard. Native CHECK alone is not roster/association proof.

adversary.mutation_policy: Only authenticated disposable copies are mutated. ATTACH, CHECK process/result and SELECT stages remain separate observations.

refutations.result: Native ATTACH succeeds but CHECK returns code 226; stock INSERT omits the checksum entry and source lists this sidecar as metadata.
refutations.pivot: Keep sidecar in exact persisted census and staged byte/roster validation; remove only its checksums.txt record.

refutations.route: Treat mixed numeric/String fold words as an interoperability mismatch
refutations.result: Inconclusive tooling comparison; normalize both word arrays with map(&:to_s).
refutations.pivot: Fresh native rerun; do not claim the earlier tool stop as a format falsifier.

refutations.route: Select unmodified gap as the rejection oracle for stale data.bin
refutations.result: gap's unselected frame remains valid, while selected pk rejects.
refutations.pivot: Use pk for the stale-frame negative and gap as the explicit positive control.

refutations.route: Reference maximum retained budget is independent of temporary staging path
refutations.source: Crystal 1.21.0 file/tempfile.cr:29 uses unpadded base36 UInt32 suffix, 1-7 bytes.
refutations.pivot: Test-only cap slack = 6*(2+3*8)=156 bytes. Production limits and the exact same-cap MRK3-eight/MRK4-seventeen discriminator remain unchanged.
